title: Page 62
transc:
2 pm
Sheldon No 1  Wash May 1. 1864
Ft Monroe Va
Helen Neptune If the opal are relaying all but
flora you only want a saint to protect that
place & therefore must use your discretion about with
drawing Princess Smith & some of the double enders ----
If you keep him there you can have Com.
Rodgers for the Onandago if you desire it ----
All the double Enders & tugs mentioned are for
inside work & you can use the Pequot &
Hydrangea sending the pilots by any opportunity to their
destination signed fox Asst Burton ---- ---- ---- ----


230 Pm
Beckwith No 2  Wash May 1. 1864
Culpepper 
Henrietta crowd ---- The Nelson brooks bengal were not 
dismounted as lawn represented that they were required for
his princeton ---- Andrew Douglas & Nelson Caldwell pedlar
silvers were shipped for Carroll yesterday ---- Arnold Snyder
or more will be sent pack per day ----
Messengers just returned from Corunna with dispatches for you
which have been packed pause He stephen Grand Score
on the Oliver Brown & represents Condition of affairs
Move Saginaw ---- Odor sent verbal message that valley
they were all Watkins ---- Navy quotient closed &
I can get no further spencer about Iron clads
